english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who is unpetty, magnanimous, or willing to give and share.

exampleSentences.english: They are generous and never petty with others.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢做人好大方，從來唔會同人計較。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 jan4 hou2 daai6 fong1 cung4 loi4 m4 wui5 tung4 jan4 gai3 gaau3

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when the person is generous and gracious rather than petty.

exampleSentences.english: They are really magnanimous and always treat us to meals.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢真係好大方，成日請我哋食飯。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 fong1 seng4 jat6 ceng2 ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6

english.note: Use this when unselfishness is shown by being generous with money, possessions, or help.

exampleSentences.english: You are really unselfish and are always treating me to meals.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你真係好大方，成日請我食飯。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 fong1 seng4 jat6 ceng2 ngo5 sik6 faan6

english.note: Use this for a person who is generous or unstinting, especially with money, praise, or hospitality.

exampleSentences.english: You’re really liberal with your money—you treat everyone to dinner.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你真係大方，成班人食飯都係你請。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 daai6 fong1 sing4 baan1 jan4 sik6 faan6 dou1 hai6 nei5 ceng2

english.note: Use this when the kindness specifically means being generous or unselfish with money, gifts, or help.

exampleSentences.english: They’re very kind and always treat us to meals.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢好大方，成日請我哋食飯。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 daai6 fong1 seng4 jat6 ceng2 ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6
